row: Dr. Doug Willen: House of Chiro

Dr. Doug Willen is a practicing Chiropractor in NYC. 
"House of Chiro" is a peek behind the curtain of real chiropractic sessions. 
Follow Dr. Doug on Instagram and TikTok @drdougnyc

Sleep Apnea and Snoring Transformation "Gym": https://www.skool.com/exhalemethod/about

Free Masterclass: The Hidden Link Between Snoring, Mouth Breathing & Sleep Apnea
If you snore, mouth breathe, wake up tired, or rely on CPAP, this matters. In this free 75-minute masterclass, Dr. Doug breaks down how breathing mechanics, tongue posture, and airway function quietly sabotage your sleep and what you can start doing differently. This is the foundation behind The Exhale Method™ and the Breathing Gym. It is where real change begins, not quick fixes.

👉 Watch the full masterclass here:
https://drdougwillen.easywebinar.live/ExhaleMethod

📍 636 Broadway, Suite 304 A New York, NY 10012

Dr. Doug is also an Animal Chiropractor, check out his other channel:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyzGslwGeHYbXiMefePIbPw
